meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Extend Submission Time" opens the "Increase Event Time" window
warnings: moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen
moved open_prepared to the front — every later step acts on that screen

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid; this is the required starting screen for prepared-state cases.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the RFQ event.
Apply the requested RFQ counter-offer visibility configuration.
Apply the requested bidding-time rejection configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the RFQ stage whose settings contain Extend Submission Time.
Open the Responses tab specified by the scenario.
Choose the RFQ Settings action and leave the Increase Event Time window open without confirming it.
Assert that the opened window offers exactly the required duration and timing options.
Verify the dialog provides a Cancel button.
Verify the dialog provides an Ok button.
